title: Senior HR Executive
jobDescription:
Senior HR Executive Senior HR Executive Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and proactive Senior HR Executive to manage and elevate our Human Resources operations. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in employee onboarding, employee engagement, HR operations, and performance management. You will play a pivotal role in nurturing our vibrant workplace culture, ensuring seamless integration for new hires, resolving employee relations matters, and collaborating with business leaders to align HR strategies with company growth. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account on our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Onboarding & Orientation: Drive a seamless, comprehensive onboarding and induction experience for all new hires, ensuring smooth integration into the company culture, policies, and their respective project teams. Employee Engagement & Culture Building: Design, plan, and execute robust employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, team-building activities, and wellness programs to foster a highly motivated and inclusive work environment. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling: Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees, effectively managing grievances, resolving conflicts, and maintaining a positive, transparent workplace. HR Operations & Policy Implementation: Drive day-to-day HR administrative operations, maintain accurate HRIS database records, and ensure HR policies and procedures are clearly communicated and consistently applied. Performance Management System (PMS): Assist leadership in executing quarterly and annual performance review cycles, tracking KPIs/KRAs, and facilitating continuous feedback mechanisms. Retention & Exit Management: Conduct regular pulse checks and exit interviews, analyze attrition trends, implement effective employee retention strategies, and handle smooth offboarding procedures. Statutory Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to labor laws, company policies, statutory compliances, and internal governance standards. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of core HR experience. Prior experience in the IT/Software industry is MANDATORY.

EDUCATION:
Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree (Specialization in Human Resources/MBA HR is preferred). Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation abilities. Location: Based in Pune (located near the office or actively willing to relocate nearby). Availability: Immediate joiner or maximum 15 days notice period . Technical & Functional Skills Onboarding & Employee Engagement New Hire Induction & Integration Frameworks Rewards, Recognition, and Wellness Programs Employee Pulse Surveys & Feedback Analysis Internal Communications & Corporate Event Planning Core HR & HRIS HR Operations, Documentation & Lifecycle Management HRIS Tools (e.g., Keka, Darwinbox, Zoho People, or similar) Attendance, Leave, and Separation Management Systems Analytics & Compliance HR Metrics, Attrition Analysis, and Reporting MS Office Suite (Advanced Excel, Power Point, Word) Basic understanding of Indian Labor Laws & HR Statutory Compliances Preferred Qualifications Proven track record of managing end-to-end employee lifecycles in a fast-paced IT environment. Demonstrated experience in handling conflict resolution, employee counseling, and implementing performance improvement plans (PIPs). Strong creative mindset for developing unique and impactful engagement strategies that boost morale and retention. Professional certification in HR (e.g., SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent) is an added advantage. title: Lead .Net Developer
jobDescription:
Lead .Net Developer Lead .Net Developer Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Lead .NET Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in .NET technologies, Microservices architecture, and Unit testing, along with experience leading a team and delivering high-quality software solutions. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account on our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using C# and .NET/.NET Core. Architect and implement Microservices-based applications. Lead a team of developers by providing technical guidance and conducting code reviews. Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services. Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following best practices. Create and maintain unit test cases to ensure code quality and application reliability. Troubleshoot and resolve performance and production issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, QA, and Dev Ops. Participate in application design, estimation, and sprint planning. Required Skills Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Core/.NET
8. Hands-on experience with Microservices architecture. Experience developing and consuming REST APIs. Strong knowledge of Entity Framework Core and SQL Server. Experience writing unit test cases using x Unit, NUnit, or MSTest. Familiarity with dependency injection, design patterns, and SOLID principles. Experience with Git and Azure Dev Ops or similar CI/CD tools. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Preferred Skills Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of Azure/AWS cloud services. Experience with messaging technologies such as Rabbit MQ or Kafka. Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Excellent communication, leadership, and mentoring skills. title: Salesforce QA Engineer
jobDescription:
Salesforce QA Engineer Salesforce QA Engineer Job Summary We are looking for a Salesforce QA Engineer with 5+ years of experience in testing Salesforce applications. The ideal candidate should have expertise in manual and automation testing, Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, and end-to-end validation of Salesforce implementations. Experience in the Healthcare domain is preferred. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account on our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Salesforce applications. Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Validate Salesforce customizations, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and integrations. Test Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and custom applications. Perform API testing using tools such as Postman. Identify, document, track, and verify defects using Jira or similar defect management tools. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to understand business requirements. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Support release validation and production deployments. Ensure overall product quality by implementing QA best practices. Required Skills 5+ years of experience in Software QA with at least 3+ years of Salesforce testing. Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Experience in testing Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex customizations, and Salesforce Flows. Hands-on experience with manual testing and automation testing. Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Provar, or Copado Robotic Testing. Knowledge of API testing using Postman or similar tools. Experience with SQL/SOQL for data validation. Familiarity with Jira, Azure Dev Ops, or similar ALM tools. Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience testing Salesforce integrations with third-party applications. Healthcare domain experience is preferred. Salesforce Administrator or QA-related Salesforce certification is an added advantage. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Salesforce DX is a plus. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Preferred Candidate Profile 5+ years of Salesforce QA experience. Healthcare domain experience is preferred. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Immediate joiners or candidates serving a short notice period will be preferred. title: Salesforce Developer
jobDescription:
Salesforce Developer Salesforce Developer Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Salesforce solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Salesforce development, integrations, and Lightning technologies. Candidates with prior experience in the Healthcare domain will be given preference. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, customize, and maintain Salesforce applications. Develop scalable solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Aura Components. Configure Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, approval processes, and Flows. Develop and consume REST/SOAP APIs for third-party integrations. Integrate Salesforce with external systems using middleware or APIs. Optimize application performance and troubleshoot production issues. Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices. Work closely with business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to gather and implement requirements. Participate in deployment activities using CI/CD tools and Salesforce DX. Maintain technical documentation and support production releases. Required Skills 5+ years of experience in Salesforce Development. Strong expertise in: Apex Programming Lightning Web Components (LWC) Aura Components Visualforce SOQL & SOSL Salesforce Flows Triggers Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP). Knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Experience with Salesforce DX, Git, and CI/CD tools. Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and profiles. Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience in Healthcare Cloud or healthcare-related Salesforce implementations. Knowledge of HL7, FHIR, or healthcare integrations is an added advantage. Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification. Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Familiarity with Mule Soft or other integration platforms is a plus. title: Curriculum Developer
jobDescription:
Curriculum Developer Curriculum Developer Responsibilities Design and develop comprehensive curricula for AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Data Engineering, and Cloud Data Platforms. Create instructor-led training (ILT), virtual instructor-led training (VILT), self-paced e-learning modules, and blended learning programs. Develop learner guides, instructor guides, presentations, assessments, quizzes, assignments, case studies, and hands-on labs. Create practical projects and capstone assignments based on real-world business scenarios. Design technical learning paths for beginner, intermediate, and advanced learners. Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), technical trainers, and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and relevance. Update existing learning content based on new technologies, platform updates, and industry trends. Create certification preparation materials and competency-based assessments. Ensure all learning content follows instructional design best practices and adult learning principles. Measure learner feedback and continuously improve course quality and learning outcomes. Maintain documentation, version control, and content repositories for all training materials. Required Skills AI & Machine Learning Artificial Intelligence fundamentals Machine Learning concepts and algorithms Deep Learning Generative AI Large Language Models (LLMs) Prompt Engineering Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI Agents Model Evaluation AI Ethics and Responsible AI Data Engineering Python SQL Apache Spark / Py Spark Apache Airflow ETL/ELT Pipelines Data Warehousing Data Lakes Data Modeling Data Quality and Data Governance Batch and Stream Processing Cloud Platforms Experience with one or more: Microsoft Azure Amazon Web Services (AWS) Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Data Technologies Experience with one or more: Snowflake Databricks Azure Data Factory Big Query Amazon Redshift Kafka Learning & Content Development Curriculum Design Instructional Design Adult Learning Principles Assessment Design Technical Writing Storyboarding LMS platforms (Moodle, Canvas, Cornerstone, Docebo, etc.) Articulate Storyline or similar e-learning authoring tools (preferred) Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Education, or a related field. 4–8+ years of experience in AI, Data Engineering, Technical Training, Instructional Design, or Curriculum Development. Experience creating technical learning content for enterprise or professional learners. Strong communication, presentation, and technical writing skills. Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into engaging learning experiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience delivering technical training. Industry certifications in AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or AI/ML. Experience with Generative AI tools such as Chat GPT, Git Hub Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar. title: Fullstack .Net Developer
jobDescription:
Fullstack .Net Developer Fullstack .Net Developer Job Summary We are looking for a skilled and motivated ASP.NET + Angular Full Stack Developer with 4–5 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Microsoft .NET technologies, Angular, RESTful APIs, SQL Server, and modern software development practices. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications using ASP.NET and Angular. Build scalable RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core/Web API. Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using Angular (v10+ preferred). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver high-quality solutions. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following coding standards and best practices. Optimize application performance and troubleshoot production issues. Perform code reviews and participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives. Work with SQL Server to design database schemas, write stored procedures, and optimize queries. Ensure application security, scalability, and reliability. Required Skills: Backend Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, and .NET Framework/.NET Core. Experience in developing RESTful APIs and Web Services. Good understanding of Entity Framework and LINQ. Knowledge of dependency injection and design patterns. Frontend Hands-on experience with Angular (v10 or above). Strong knowledge of Type Script, Java Script, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and responsive web design. Experience with Angular components, services, routing, forms, and state management. Database Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server. Proficiency in writing SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning. Tools & Technologies Git/Azure Dev Ops or other version control systems. Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code. Experience with CI/CD pipelines is an added advantage. Knowledge of Azure cloud services is a plus. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 4–5 years of hands-on experience in Full Stack Development using ASP.NET and Angular. title: Content Creation & Instructional Designer
jobDescription:
Content Creation & Instructional Designer Content Creation & Instructional Designer Responsibilities Technical Content Development Design and develop technical enablement content including e-learning modules (SCORM/x API), videos, assessments, instructor-led training (ILT), and virtual instructor-led training (VILT). Translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging, and learner-centric content for technical practitioners. Create and maintain training curricula, learning paths, certification preparation materials, and onboarding programs. Develop support-focused resources such as troubleshooting guides, playbooks, runbooks, FAQs, and knowledge base articles. Learning Platform Administration Publish, manage, and maintain training content within Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Docebo or similar platforms. Monitor learner engagement, completion rates, and training effectiveness through LMS reporting and analytics. Support hands-on learning experiences through lab authoring and delivery platforms such as Vocareum or equivalent solutions. Technical Enablement Develop enablement materials covering cloud technologies, data platforms, analytics tools, and enterprise software solutions. Continuously learn new product features, technologies, and platform capabilities, translating them into scalable training and enablement programs. Partner with technical SMEs to ensure content accuracy, relevance, and alignment with business objectives. Design learning experiences that improve technical proficiency and accelerate employee onboarding and productivity. Support Enablement Create training programs that improve support engineer productivity, troubleshooting capabilities, and customer issue resolution. Build content aligned with support workflows, escalation processes, SLA management, and knowledge management best practices. Drive initiatives that improve case deflection, reduce ramp-up time, and increase support team confidence. Maintain and enhance support documentation to ensure consistent knowledge sharing across teams. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Support Operations, and Enablement teams to identify training needs and prioritize content development. Communicate project status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leadership. Manage multiple concurrent enablement projects while balancing priorities, timelines, and business requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Education Technology, Instructional Design, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Technical Enablement, Technical Training, Learning & Development, Technical Writing, or a related role. Proven experience creating technical enablement content across multiple formats, including e-learning, assessments, videos, and instructor-led training. Experience with LMS platforms such as Docebo or similar systems. Experience with lab authoring and delivery platforms such as Vocareum or equivalent. Familiarity with video creation and screen-recording tools such as Camtasia, Loom, or similar technologies. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in technical environments. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with cloud technologies, data platforms, enterprise applications, or software development environments. Experience supporting technical support organizations or customer support enablement programs. Knowledge of support operations, ticket management processes, escalation frameworks, and service-level agreements (SLAs). Experience developing knowledge bases, troubleshooting documentation, operational playbooks, and runbooks. Understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies. title: SEO Specialist
jobDescription:
SEO Specialist SEO Specialist Job Summary We are looking for a skilled and results-oriented SEO Specialist with 5+ years of experience in search engine optimization and digital marketing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in improving website rankings, increasing organic traffic, and implementing effective on-page and off-page SEO strategies. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve website visibility and search engine rankings. Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, and SEO audits. Optimize website content, landing pages, metadata, and internal linking structure. Manage on-page, off-page, and technical SEO activities. Monitor website performance using SEO and analytics tools. Track and report organic traffic, keyword rankings, and campaign performance. Collaborate with content, design, and development teams to implement SEO best practices. Build and manage backlink strategies to improve domain authority. Stay updated with the latest SEO trends, search engine algorithms, and digital marketing practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, IT, Communications, or related field. 5+ years of experience in SEO and digital marketing. Strong knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO. Experience with SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, or similar platforms. Understanding of keyword research, link-building strategies, and website analytics. Basic knowledge of HTML, Word Press, and website optimization techniques. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobDescription:
Digital Marketing Manager Digital Marketing Manager Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Marketing Manager with 8+ years of experience in marketing, branding, and campaign management. The ideal candidate should have proven expertise in planning, executing, and managing successful marketing campaigns across multiple channels to drive brand awareness, customer engagement, and business growth. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement strategic marketing plans aligned with business objectives. Lead and execute end-to-end marketing campaigns across digital, social media, email, events, and offline channels. Manage campaign planning, budgeting, execution, optimization, and performance analysis. Collaborate with internal teams including sales, product, and creative teams to ensure campaign success. Track and analyze campaign KPIs and prepare performance reports with actionable insights. Drive lead generation, customer acquisition, and brand-building initiatives. Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities and trends. Manage external agencies, vendors, and marketing partners. Mentor and guide junior marketing team members. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field. 8+ years of experience in marketing and campaign management. Proven experience in successfully running and managing marketing campaigns. Strong understanding of digital marketing, branding, and performance marketing strategies. Hands-on experience with marketing tools and analytics platforms. Excellent communication, leadership, and project management skills. jobDescription:
Node.js Developer Node.js Developer Responsibilities Develop and maintain server-side applications using Node.js . Design and build RESTful APIs and microservices. Ensure high performance and responsiveness of applications. Collaborate with front-end developers, product managers, and other stakeholders. Integrate third-party APIs and services. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field. Strong proficiency in Node.js and frameworks like Express.js. Experience with Java Script (ES6+). Knowledge of RESTful APIs and API integration. Experience with databases such as Mongo DB , My SQL , or Postgre SQL. Understanding of asynchronous programming and event-driven architecture. Familiarity with version control tools like Git. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus. Understanding of containerization tools like Docker is an advantage. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Knowledge of microservices architecture. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines. Basic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, Java Script frameworks). Soft Skills Strong problem-solving skills. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Ability to work independently and manage time effectively. title: Senior Data Analyst
jobDescription:
Senior Data Analyst Senior Data Analyst Responsibilities Analyze large and complex datasets to extract meaningful insights and support strategic business decisions. Design, develop, and maintain forecasting models (time series, regression, etc.) for business planning and performance tracking. Work extensively with Databricks and Spark for data processing, transformation, and analytics. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions. Build interactive dashboards and reports to effectively communicate insights to stakeholders. Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency across multiple data sources. Optimize data pipelines, queries, and workflows for improved performance and scalability. Required Skills & Qualifications 7+ years of experience in Data Analytics or a related domain. Strong proficiency in SQL and data manipulation techniques. Hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark. Experience in building and validating forecasting models. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Experience with data visualization tools (AI/BI tools preferred). Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL processes. title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobDescription:
Senior Technical Program Manager Senior Technical Program Manager

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Migration Accelerator Development: Research, develop, and deliver 100 technical migration guides (Accelerators) aligned to specific source systems including Snowflake, Big Query, Redshift, Hadoop, Teradata, and Netezza. Technical Benchmarking: Evaluate and benchmark partner tooling approaches to refine the Databricks Partner Recommendation (BU+1) engine. Field Activation & Execution: Lead the organization and scaling of “Partner Prospecting Days,” facilitating two global events per month to drive sales and enablement. Data-Driven Governance: Establish internal monitoring for Partner NPS and feedback; deliver monthly NPS summaries and quarterly tooling benchmarks to program leadership. Program Management: Participate in weekly syncs with the Global Program Lead to review progress against a high-volume deliverable schedule. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of cloud migration strategies and source system architectures (e.g., Data Warehousing, Hadoop, SQL). Data Analysis: Ability to analyze NPS data and technical performance metrics to refine recommendation logic and program quality. Project Leadership: Proven experience managing high-volume deliverables (e.g., 100+ technical units/year) and coordinating large-scale field events. Key Deliverables: 100 Migration Accelerators per year with Tooling/methodology validation. 24 Partner Prospecting Day events per year. Quarterly Partner Tooling Benchmarks and Monthly NPS Summaries. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior Dev Ops Engineer Senior Dev Ops Engineer Job Description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Dev Ops Developer to join our dynamic technology team. The ideal candidate will be skilled in modern Dev Ops frameworks and possess a deep understanding of infrastructure as code principles. This role involves managing & deploying microservices architecture that requires hands-on approach in automating infrastructure development, with a strong focus on efficiency and scalability. As Dev Ops Engineer, you are responsible for setup and maintain Dev Ops tools, Cloud monitoring tools, Cloud security. The Dev Ops engineer needs to be agile enough to wear a technical hat while simultaneously managing operations. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Roles &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Deploying, automating, maintaining and managing multi-cloud / hybrid environment such as Azure, AWS and GCP cloud based production systems, to ensure availability, performance, scalability and security of production systems. Manage tools for automation and configuration management such as Jenkin, Puppet, Chef, Ansible or any equivalent. Work on App Containerization, Docker / Kubernetes / EKS implementation on AWS/ Azure & Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope, quality & within budget. Work with Application Performance Management (APM) tools such as New Relic, Data Dog or any other equivalent log management tool. Work on essential Functions System Architecture Process Design and Implementation. Strong influencing and relationship-building skills with stakeholders across Service Lines, Platform Managers, Business team and external Suppliers. Experience creating and managing Kubernetes cluster and Namespaces. Work on migrating Applications from monolithic to microservices architecture. Good understanding of with Continuous Integration(CI) and Continuous Deployment(CD) pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Flex CD, Argo CD, Spinnaker etc and Dev Sec Ops integration from PR process to Unit Testing, System Testing and deployment. Innovate in the development and enhancement of instrumentation for monitoring and logging, ensuring the robustness and availability of services. Working knowledge of key value stores, database technologies (SQL and No SQL), Mongo, My SQL. Creating and managing IAM roles and policies. Good written and oral communication skills. Understanding of writing scripts for integrating applications in pipeline, server infrastructure, Selenium, Checkmarx or alternative solution for SAST and DAST, Git Hub, Azure Dev Ops, Splunk and similar tools. Qualification Required: The candidate should have 6 to 8 years of experience as a Dev Ops Engineer. Strong educational background, preferably in the fields of computer science or engineering. Strong background in Windows/ i OS / Linux / Unix Administration and troubleshooting. Experience in capacity management/patching, load balancer and ingress controllers. Experience using Dev Ops tools such as Terraform, Git Hub and Jenkins. Dev Ops Engineer with a minimum of 5 years’ experience should be able to implement the provided solutions. Hands-on experience in conducting Cloud assessment and migration, especially AWS Infrastructure such as EC2, RDS, Elastic cache, S3, kafka / Kinesis, Lambda etc. Problem-Solving : Ability to analyze and resolve complex infrastructure resource and application deployment issues. Showcase a solid understanding of operating systems concepts, particularly in the context of Linux environments. Exhibit hands-on expertise in the installation, configuration, operation, and monitoring of Observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana. title: Partner Manager – Product
jobDescription:
Partner Manager – Product Partner Manager – Product Responsibilities Build and manage strategic relationships with product partners, ISVs, resellers, and platform providers. Develop and execute joint go-to-market (GTM) strategies to drive product adoption and revenue growth. Identify market opportunities and align partner capabilities with our product offerings. Drive partner onboarding, enablement, and ongoing engagement through training, demos, and workshops. Collaborate with Product, Sales, and Marketing teams to position and scale partner-led solutions. Track partner performance, pipeline contribution, and revenue impact. Support deal closures by working closely with partners on proposals, pricing, and negotiations. Represent the company at partner events, product launches, and industry forums. Required Skills & Qualifications Minimum 5 years of experience in Partner Management / Alliances / Channel Sales, preferably in product-based environments. Strong understanding of product lifecycle, Saa S models, and platform ecosystems. Experience working with product partners, marketplaces, or ISVs. Proven ability to build and manage strategic partnerships and complex deal cycles. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong business acumen with the ability to translate product value into partner-driven growth. Preferred Skills Experience with Saa S products, APIs, integrations, and platform partnerships. Understanding of product-led growth (PLG) and partner-led growth (PLG 2.0) models. Existing network within the product and startup ecosystem. MBA or Technical Degree preferred . title: Databricks Business Trainer
jobDescription:
Databricks Business Trainer Databricks Business Trainer Responsibilities Conduct training sessions for business users, clients, and stakeholders. Explain business use cases of Databricks across industries (finance, retail, healthcare, etc.). Translate technical data concepts into simple business language. Develop training materials including presentations, case studies, and documentation. Demonstrate how data-driven insights can improve business performance and decision-making. Support adoption of Databricks within client organization. Collaborate with technical teams to align training with real-world implementations. Deliver workshops, demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, IT, or related field. 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis / Data Analysis / Pre-sales / Corporate Training, on Databricks. Strong communication and presentation skills. Good understanding of business processes for Databricks and data-driven decision-making. Ability to simplify complex technical Databricks concepts for non-technical audiences. Strong knowledge of data analytics concepts and tools. Experience in stakeholder or client interaction. Must Have Knowledge of BI tools like Power BI or Tableau. Good understanding of SQL or data querying. Experience in corporate training or L&D. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Key Competencies Excellent storytelling and presentation skills. Strong business acumen. Problem-solving mindset. Ability to engage and influence stakeholders. title: AI/ML Engineer (Generative AI & LLMs)
jobDescription:
AI/ML Engineer (Generative AI & LLMs) AI/ML Engineer (Generative AI & LLMs) Responsibilities AI / ML Development: Design and build AI-powered applications using transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) . Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for context-aware AI systems. Implement prompt engineering techniques to improve LLM accuracy and performance. title: Lead Generation Executive
jobDescription:
Lead Generation Executive Lead Generation Executive Responsibilities Identify and research potential clients for IT services and IT product offerings. Generate leads through cold calling, email campaigns, Linked In outreach, and online research. Qualify prospects based on business needs, budget, and relevance to company offerings. Maintain and update lead information in CRM systems or internal databases. Schedule meetings, calls, or product demonstrations for the sales team with qualified leads. Build and manage a consistent pipeline of potential customers. Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to align lead generation strategies. Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities and target industries. Follow up with prospects to nurture relationships and move them through the sales funnel. Track and report lead generation activities, conversion rates, and performance metrics. Required Skills & Qualifications 1+ year of experience in lead generation, preferably in IT services or IT products. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related field. Experience in B2B lead generation and prospecting. Strong knowledge of cold calling, email outreach, and Linked In prospecting. Familiarity with CRM tools and lead management systems. Good understanding of IT services, software products, or technology solutions. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong research and analytical skills to identify potential clients and opportunities. Ability to work independently and meet lead generation targets. Basic knowledge of lead generation tools such as Linked In Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar platforms. Must Have 1+ year experience in B2B lead generation (preferably IT services/products). Experience using Linked In Sales Navigator for lead sourcing. Strong research and prospecting skills to identify potential clients. Experience with cold emailing, Linked In outreach, and lead qualification . Knowledge of CRM tools like Hub Spot, Service Now, or Salesforce . Good communication and coordination with the sales team . Good to Have Experience using tools like Linked In Sales Navigator, Apollo, Zoom Info, or Hub Spot. Exposure to B2B sales processes in the IT industry. Experience working with international clients or global markets. Ensure accurate processing of invoices, vendor payments, and employee payroll transactions . Maintain and update financial records, documentation, and reports . Assist in preparing financial reports, reconciliations, and analysis . Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up for timely collections. Verify vendor invoices and process payments in compliance with company policies . Coordinate with internal teams to resolve finance-related queries and discrepancies . Ensure adherence to financial policies, procedures, and compliance requirements . Support the finance team with data analysis and reporting as required. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 2–3 years of experience in finance operations or corporate finance roles.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in B.Com or M.Com . Hands-on experience in any two of the following areas: Payroll Accounts Payable (AP) Accounts Receivable (AR) Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and financial processes . Proficiency in MS Excel and financial reporting tools. Excellent verbal and written communication skills . Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills . Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks efficiently . Candidates should be able to join within 15 days and be willing to work from Pune . Good to Have Basic knowledge of financial reporting and reconciliation processes . Familiarity with accounting software or ERP systems . Experience working in corporate finance or consulting environments . Understanding of financial compliance and internal controls . Strong attention to detail and time management skills . Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams . title: PostgreSQL / T-SQL Developer
jobDescription:
Postgre SQL / T-SQL Developer Postgre SQL / T-SQL Developer Roles & Responsibilities Develop and maintain database logic using PL/pg SQL in Postgre SQL. Design and implement stored procedures, functions, and complex SQL queries. Work on T-SQL logic and support migration from SQL Server to Postgre SQL. Implement robust error handling and exception management in database code. Develop data warehouse queries using advanced SQL functions such as Rollup, Cube, and Grouping Sets. Perform database performance tuning and query optimization to improve system efficiency. Design and maintain database schemas, tables, and relationships. Troubleshoot and resolve production-level database issues. Collaborate with development and data teams to deliver efficient database solutions. Required Skills & Qualifications 10+ years of experience in database development. Strong hands-on experience in Postgre SQL and PL/pg SQL development. Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL logic/migration. Strong expertise in database performance tuning and query optimization. Experience with Data Warehousing concepts and advanced SQL aggregations (Rollup, Cube, Grouping Sets). Strong knowledge of error handling and exception management in database programming. Hands-on experience with database schema design and data modeling. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. title: UI/UX Designer
jobDescription:
UI/UX Designer UI/UX Designer requirements and user needs into functional, visually appealing designs through research, wireframing, prototyping, and collaboration with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate combines creativity with analytical thinking to deliver seamless and impactful user experiences. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Roles & Responsibilities Design intuitive and visually compelling user interfaces for web and mobile applications. Create wireframes, mockups, user flows, and interactive prototypes. Conduct user research and basic usability testing to validate design decisions. Translate business and technical requirements into user-friendly design solutions. Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders. Ensure consistency in design systems and adherence to brand guidelines. Apply user-centered design principles and industry best practices. Iterate designs based on user feedback and data insights. Required Skills & Qualifications Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar platforms. Strong understanding of user-centered design (UCD) principles and usability standards. Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs. Basic knowledge of usability testing methodologies. Strong creative, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, or related field. title: DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Dev Ops Engineer Dev Ops Engineer Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes. Work with containerization tools like Docker. Manage cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP). Automate infrastructure provisioning using tools like Terraform or Cloud Formation. Monitor system performance and troubleshoot production issues. Ensure high availability and security of systems. Collaborate closely with development and QA teams to streamline releases. Maintain documentation for infrastructure and deployment processes. Required Skills & Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Dev Ops or related roles. Strong hands-on experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Docker and container orchestration. Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Git Lab CI, etc.). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP). Strong Linux administration skills. Good understanding of networking and security best practices. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Experience with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.). Scripting knowledge (Shell, Python, etc.). Experience with microservices architecture. Exposure to Agile/Scrum environment. Support the full analytics lifecycle: data preparation, modeling, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Collaborate with commercial and supply chain stakeholders across regions. Build solutions using Python and Azure Databricks. Required Skills & Qualifications 3–7 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics. Experience delivering production-ready analytics solutions. Exposure to commercial analytics (pricing, revenue management, or forecasting). Understanding of global supply chain dynamics. Experience with cross-sell, up-sell, or churn analytics. Strong proficiency in Python. Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks. Ability to build explainable, business-ready models. Preferred Skills Experience in agro-chemicals, agriculture inputs, FMCG, or B2B distribution models. Exposure to seasonal demand or multi-country commercial environments. Mentoring or informal team leadership experience. Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. title: Operations Manager
jobDescription:
Operations Manager Operations Manager Roles & Responsibilities As a part of an agile team environment, you are expected to independently work on end-to-end target delivery which includes – Analyze projected work volume and allocate resources to team leads based on capacity availability and SLA targets. Ensure staffing and performance levels are correct to handle appropriate amounts of work volume. Work closely with leads to decide the team rostering, shifts and team allocation Coordinates with Team Leads and resources as needed to ensure on-time delivery. Analyze workload, capacity planning and resource allocation forecasting. Participate and present data to discuss trends, status and action plans to meet targets. Proactively communicate to adjust the workforce plan based on changing volume. Effectively lead, motivate and direct the workgroup while being flexible in a changing environment. Effective communication to internal and external stakeholders on Operation status and changes. Performance management of team: Define, track and monitor KRAs for Leads and team. Accountable for adhering to defined SLA for key KPIs like Customer Satisfaction(CSAT), Customer Effort Score and Productivity. Hiring support- Proactively work with recruitment team to ensure right team is in place Work with the Learning and development team to ensure the right induction plan is in place. Job Requirements/Qualifications Educational Qualification: Any graduate and above Should have 5+ years of hands-on progressive project/operations management work experience in fast-paced development/operations organization. Should have experience in running 24*7 support operations. Should have hands-on experience in Reporting, building Weekly, Monthly and Quarterly reports. title: Business Development Manager (Product Sales)
jobDescription:
Business Development Manager (Product Sales) Business Development Manager (Product Sales) Responsibilities New Business Acquisition (Hunting): Identify and pursue new business opportunities across target industries and geographies . Own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and discovery to demo coordination and deal closure . Build and manage a strong outbound pipeline using cold calls, emails, Linked In, and events . Target mid-market and enterprise customers . Sales Execution : Conduct discovery calls to understand customer challenges and decision criteria. Work closely with Product Specialists to deliver compelling product demos of Testily and Vo Xgent . Prepare proposals, pricing, and commercial discussions . Negotiate contracts and close deals independently. Pipeline & CRM Managemen t: Maintain accurate sales pipeline and forecasts in CRM . Track key metrics: leads generated, meetings booked, pipeline value, and closures . Ensure timely follow-ups and strong deal hygiene . Market & Customer Intelligence : Stay updated on market trends, competitors, and customer needs . Provide feedback to Product and Marketing teams based on prospect conversations . Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities post initial closure (handover to farming / CS) . Required Skills & Qualifications Proven experience in a sales hunting / new logo acquisition role . Strong background in B2B Saa S, AI, or enterprise software sales . Excellent communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills . Comfortable with cold calling and outbound prospecting . Ability to sell value and outcomes—not just features . Experience selling to US or global customers is a strong plus . Self-starter with a high ownership mindset . Preferred Skills (Nice to Have) Experience selling AI, testing, CX, HRTech, or automation platforms . Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce, Hub Spot, Zoho, etc.) . Experience working with Product, Pre-sales, or Solution teams . Existing industry network or relationships . Preferred Skills (Nice to Have) Experience selling AI, testing, CX, HRTech, or automation platforms . Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce, Hub Spot, Zoho, etc.) . Experience working with Product, Pre-sales, or Solution teams . Existing industry network or relationships . title: Lead Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Lead Data Engineer Lead Data Engineer Responsibilities Lead the design, development, and maintenance of robust and scalable data pipelines using Databricks. Architect end-to-end data solutions including data ingestion, transformation, storage, and analytics. Build and optimize data workflows using Databricks, Spark, and cloud data platforms. Guide and mentor a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices and code quality. Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, analysts, and business teams to understand data requirements. Ensure data quality, governance, security, and compliance standards are met. Optimize performance and cost of data pipelines and platforms. Review technical designs, code, and deployments. Troubleshoot and resolve complex data-related issues. Participate in strategic planning and roadmap discussions for data platforms. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles. Mandatory hands-on experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, notebooks, jobs, workflows). Strong experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing. Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Expertise in data warehousing solutions (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query, etc.). Experience with ETL/ELT tools and orchestration frameworks (Airflow, dbt, etc.). Strong understanding of CI/CD, version control, and Dev Ops practices. Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience leading or mentoring data engineering teams. Knowledge of real-time data processing and streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, etc.). Exposure to BI and analytics tools. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. title: Learning and Development Manager
jobDescription:
Learning and Development Manager Learning and Development Manager Responsibilities As a part of the leadership and HR team, you will be expected to independently manage end-to-end learning and development initiatives, which include: Develop and manage comprehensive Learning & Development strategies aligned with business objectives. Conduct training needs analysis across departments to identify skill gaps and development opportunities. Design, implement, and manage training programs including onboarding, technical, behavioral, and leadership development programs. Lead leadership development and succession planning initiatives. Manage internal and external training resources, vendors, and facilitators. Measure training effectiveness using KPIs, feedback, assessments, and ROI analysis. Collaborate with senior management to align learning initiatives with organizational growth plans. Drive employee engagement through continuous learning initiatives and career development programs. Maintain training calendars, learning documentation, and MIS reports for management review. Ensure consistency in learning standards, content quality, and delivery across the organization. Promote a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Required Skills & Qualifications Master’s Degree in Human Resource Management or a related field. Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Learning & Development Manager. Strong experience in designing and implementing L&D frameworks and learning strategies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Experience with learning management systems (LMS) and modern learning methodologies. Ability to work independently and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. High level of professionalism, leadership ability, and strategic thinking. title: Digital Transformation Lead
jobDescription:
Digital Transformation Lead Digital Transformation Lead Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and manage a team of full-stack and AI developers. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify pain points and implement digital solutions aligned with business goals. Design and develop web applications using Flutter, Angular, j Query, and .NET technologies. Architect backend systems and APIs using .NET and Postgre SQL/MSSQL. Design and deploy AI / Gen AI-based tools using Python, Lang Chain, and relevant APIs. Build data pipelines for ETL processes using Python, SSIS and Apache Airflow. Integrate enterprise systems such as SAP, Primavera, Share Point, and service desks (e.g., Freshdesk). Implement containerized solutions using Docker and oversee CI/CD pipelines. Enable self-service BI/reporting for business users using Metabase or similar tools. Ensure system scalability, performance tuning, and robust documentation. Required Skills & Qualifications Frontend: Flutter, Angular (2+), j Query, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap. Backend: .NET / ASP.NET MVC, C#, RESTful APIs. Databases: Postgre SQL, MS SQL Server, basic understanding of No SQL (e.g., Mongo DB). AI & Automation: Python, Lang Chain, Open AI, OCR tools (Tesseract, Google Vision, etc.). ETL & Workflow Orchestration: Python scripting, SSIS, Apache Airflow for data workflows. Reporting & BI: Metabase (preferred), SSRS Power BI or equivalent tools. Dev Ops: Git, Azure Dev Ops or Git Hub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Docker containerization. Others:Familiar with RPA concepts and tools. 8–10 years of professional experience, including 2+ years in a leadership capacity. Prior experience in EPC, Engineering, or Construction domain is a strong plus. Education Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech), Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), or a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. jobDescription:
Data Engineer Data Engineer Job Description We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Databricks to design, build, and optimize data pipelines and workflows. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, cloud platforms, and large-scale data processing. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks. Implement data integration and transformation processes from multiple data sources. Work with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) for data storage and management. Ensure data security, governance, and compliance best practices are followed. Proficiency in SQL and Python. Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices. jobDescription:
Business Analyst cum Product manager Business Analyst cum Product manager requirements, analyzing processes, and bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. The candidate should have hands-on experience working in both Agile and Waterfall environments requirements, analyzing processes, and bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. The candidate should have hands-on experience working in both Agile and Waterfall environments. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze business requirements. Translate business needs into detailed functional and technical specifications. Work closely with project managers, developers, and QA teams to ensure successful project delivery. Support the development and implementation of business solutions using Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Conduct requirement workshops, user story creation, and backlog grooming sessions. Perform data analysis, process mapping, and impact assessments. Validate deliverables to ensure they meet business and functional requirements. Prepare and maintain project documentation including BRDs, FRDs, and user manuals. Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and technical teams. Required Skills & Qualifications 2–5 years of proven experience as a Business Analyst. Strong understanding and practical experience with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall project methodologies. Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, MS Office Suite, and Visio (or similar). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management abilities. Ability to handle multiple projects and deliver within deadlines. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. Certification in Business Analysis (CBAP, CCBA) or Agile (CSM, PMI-ACP) will be an added advantage. title: LMS Specialist
jobDescription:
LMS Specialist LMS Specialist Responsibilities Oversee the day-to-day operation of the LMS, including user account creation, course uploads, and overall system maintenance. Manage the uploading, organizing, and structuring of courses and learning content, ensuring ease of access and navigation for users. Provide technical support to users and troubleshoot issues related to the LMS, ensuring minimal disruption to the learning process. Work with instructional designers and content creators to upload and configure new courses, assessments, and multimedia content. Configure the LMS settings, features, and reporting functions to meet organizational learning needs and goals. Generate and analyse reports on learner progress, course completion, and system usage to measure the effectiveness of training programs. Maintain accurate user records and enrollments, manage user groups, and ensure data integrity within the LMS. Track and report compliance training completions, ensuring that employees complete mandatory courses within deadlines. Collaborate with LMS vendors for system upgrades, troubleshooting, and enhancements. Coordinate with internal departments to align training needs. Provide training to new users and administrators on how to use the LMS effectively, including creating and managing content. Stay informed of LMS updates and new features, ensuring smooth upgrades and implementation of new functionalities. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree and above 3+ years of experience managing and administering Learning Management Systems (LMS). Knowledge of Docebo software is preferred Proficiency with common LMS platforms Strong technical skills, with experience in configuring and troubleshooting LMS issues Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. title: Senior Technical Writer
jobDescription:
Senior Technical Writer Senior Technical Writer Responsibilities Review, edit, and publish external-facing support articles for technical accuracy, clarity, and tone. Collaborate with product, support, and engineering teams to ensure content completeness and correctness. Maintain consistency in style, structure, and terminology across all customer-facing documentation. Manage publishing workflows in CMS or knowledge base platforms (e.g., Salesforce Knowledge, Zendesk, Service Now, Confluence, etc.). Proactively identify outdated or redundant content and coordinate updates. Apply SEO best practices and accessibility standards to ensure optimal user experience. Uphold and evolve editorial standards and content quality guidelines. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, or related field. 5+ years of experience in technical writing, editing, or documentation management—preferably in a software or technology environment. Strong command of written English and attention to detail. Experience working with structured content and enterprise CMS tools. Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with support knowledge base ecosystems and best practices for external customer content. Preferred Skills Experience editing or publishing content for Saa S, enterprise support, or developer platforms Understanding of terminology management and content governance. Basic HTML or Markdown knowledge. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. What We’re Looking For Highly motivated, self-driven professionals who can take ownership of content quality Strong editorial judgment with the ability to balance technical depth and customer clarity. Team players who can work across geographies and time zones. title: Procurement Specialist
jobDescription:
Procurement Specialist Procurement Specialist Responsibilities Assist in identifying, evaluating, and selecting reliable suppliers and vendors. Collect and compare quotations to support cost-effective purchasing decisions. Raise purchase orders and track them until timely delivery. Maintain and update procurement records, documents, and vendor databases. Coordinate with internal teams to understand material/service requirements. Follow up with suppliers on order status, delivery timelines, and pending items. Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and standards. Support negotiations for pricing, terms, and service-level agreements. Monitor inventory levels and assist in replenishment planning. Resolve procurement-related issues and escalate when needed. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field. 0–1 year of experience in procurement or supply chain (freshers can apply). Basic understanding of purchasing processes and vendor management. Good communication and negotiation skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Power Point). Strong attention to detail and good analytical skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams. title: Lead Lab Developer
jobDescription:
Lead Lab Developer Lead Lab Developer Responsibilities Lead the design, development, and deployment of lab automation tools, data pipelines, and software applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (R&D, engineering, operations) to build scalable lab solutions. Architect and maintain cloud-based lab environments (Azure/AWS/GCP) with a focus on performance and security. Drive the implementation of Dev Ops/MLOps practices for continuous integration, testing, and deployment. Manage a team of developers, providing mentorship, technical guidance, and performance feedback. Ensure compliance with data security, regulatory standards, and best practices in lab environments. Identify emerging technologies and propose strategies to modernize lab systems and workflows. Oversee documentation, knowledge sharing, and training within the development team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering , or related field. 5+ years of software development experience , with at least 2+ years in a lead/managerial role. Strong programming background (Python, Java, C#, or similar). Hands-on experience with lab automation tools, Io T, or scientific computing platforms . Expertise in cloud platforms . Knowledge of data engineering, APIs, and microservices . Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and Dev Ops pipelines . Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. title: Senior Program Manager
jobDescription:
Senior Program Manager Senior Program Manager Responsibilities Lead the full lifecycle of a large-scale LMS migration project, including planning, execution, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and post-launch stabilization. Make informed decisions independently and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership. Identify potential risks and challenges in advance, developing mitigation plans to ensure project success. Collaborate cross-functionally with IT, Learning & Development, HR, Compliance, and external vendors. Develop and execute detailed project plans, communication strategies, and training plans to support a smooth rollout. Track and report on program progress, risks, milestones, and KPIs to stakeholders at all levels. Ensure data integrity, business continuity, and user experience are maintained throughout the migration process. Required Skills & Qualifications 8+ years of program or project management experience, with a focus on digital learning or enterprise system implementations. Proven experience leading at least one large-scale LMS migration or deployment (e.g., Cornerstone, Workday, Success Factors, Moodle, etc.). Strong strategic thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to anticipate challenges. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence across all levels of the organization. Demonstrated ability to operate independently and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications PMP, Agile, or equivalent project management certification. Experience in change management, learning experience design, or enterprise IT environments. Familiarity with integrations (e.g., SSO, HRIS, content libraries). Background in global or multi-region LMS rollouts. title: Senior Java Developer
jobDescription:
Senior Java Developer Senior Java Developer Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance applications using Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and microservices architecture. Build and consume RESTful APIs for internal and external integrations. Work with relational and No SQL databases such as My SQL and Mongo DB. Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms ( AWS / GCP / Azure ). Implement CI/CD pipelines using Git, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins, and other Dev Ops tools. Work with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features. Troubleshoot production issues and ensure timely resolution. Follow best practices for coding standards, testing methodologies, and performance optimization. Required Skills & Qualifications Minimum 7+ years of hands-on Java development experience. Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, REST APIs, and Microservices. Experience with databases such as My SQL and Mongo DB. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Maven/Gradle. Practical knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience with message brokers (Kafka/Rabbit MQ). Familiarity with distributed systems and event-driven architecture. Knowledge of performance tuning and application monitoring tools. title: Instructional Designer
jobDescription:
Instructional Designer Instructional Designer Responsibilities Analyze learning needs and identify learning objectives through collaboration with subject matter experts (SMEs) and stakeholders. Design instructional materials including storyboards, e Learning modules, ILT guides, job aids, and assessments. Develop content using authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, or similar. Implement learning solutions using Learning Management Systems (LMS) like Moodle, Cornerstone, Workday, or Talent LMS. Apply instructional design theories (ADDIE, SAM, Bloom’s Taxonomy, etc.) to optimize learning effectiveness. Create engaging and interactive training materials that cater to various learning styles. Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics. Maintain version control and ensure content accuracy and consistency. Stay current with trends in learning technologies and instructional design best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Human Resources, or a related field (Master’s preferred). 3+ years of experience in instructional design or curriculum development. Skills: Proficiency in e Learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Storyline, Rise, Captivate, Camtasia). Familiarity with LMS platforms and SCORM/AICC/x API standards. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Visual design skills and experience with graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite) are a plus. Experience with video editing and multimedia production is a bonus. title: Curriculum Lead
jobDescription:
Curriculum Lead Curriculum Lead Responsibilities Curriculum Design & Development: Lead the end-to-end design, development, and enhancement of curriculum and training materials. Ensure content is aligned with industry best practices, organizational objectives, and learner needs. Develop competency frameworks and learning paths for various roles and skill levels. Integrate modern learning methodologies, including blended learning, microlearning, and digital learning. Quality Assurance & Evaluation: Establish and maintain standards for instructional quality, accuracy, and relevance. Review and evaluate curriculum effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics. Implement continuous improvement strategies based on learner feedback and industry trends. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with subject matter experts (SMEs), instructional designers, and trainers to produce engaging content. Work closely with HR, L&D, and business leaders to align curriculum with skill development strategies. Coordinate with technology teams for LMS integration and e Learning development. Leadership & Team Management: Mentor and guide instructional designers and content developers. Allocate resources effectively and manage curriculum development timelines. Ensure team compliance with instructional design principles and organizational policies. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Education, Instructional Design, Curriculum Development, or related field. 7+ years of experience in curriculum design, instructional design, or learning program management. Proven experience leading end-to-end curriculum development projects. Strong knowledge of instructional design models (ADDIE, SAM, Bloom’s Taxonomy, etc.). Proficiency with e Learning authoring tools (Articulate 360, Captivate, etc.) and LMS platforms. Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. Familiarity with emerging learning technologies and trends. jobDescription:
Dot Net Technical Lead Dot Net Technical Lead requirements to design, develop, and implement highly efficient, highly scalable system solutions and is responsible for delivering high-quality projects to Tudip clients. Individuals in this role should have strong analytical and problem solving skills, and enjoy hands-on programming work and good team leading experience. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Roles and Responsibilities Leading and guiding teams of software engineers Be responsible for the quality (both code level and functional level ) of software and help address any client satisfaction issues Provide strong communication skills via education and mentoring to team members, business users, and technology colleagues. Designing, developing and implementing quality solutions to meet complex project requirements as per defined timelines. Exercising independent judgment in evaluating alternative technical solutions. Participating in the code and design review process. Provide technical leadership, development, POCs, standardize the integrations, define the best practices and ensure timely completion of assigned work. Writing unit test cases for quality check of the deliverables. Suggesting new processes, tools, techniques etc to improve the quality of work. Constantly upgrading by learning technologies beyond traditional areas of expertise. Job Requirements/Qualifications Educational Qualification: BE, BTech, MTech, MCA from a reputed institute. Min 7+ years of hands-on experience in programming. Should know C#, MVC6, and Web API2 really well. Good hands-on experience on an ORM (Peta Poco OR Entity Framework OR NHibernate OR Dapper) is a MUST. Daily working experience on Source Control Management tools like Git/SVN and Project Management tools like Jira/Redmine/Trello is a MUST. Vast experience in designing the HTML5, CSS3, web 2.0 UI is a HUGE plus. Good hands-on experience on Material Design and Bootstrap is a HUGE plus. Understanding of responsive design is a HUGE plus. Past experience of Telerik is again a HUGE plus. Past experience with TFS/Azure is a HUGE plus. Earlier experience of direct client interaction is a HUGE plus. Excellent written and oral communication skills. title: Java Developer
jobDescription:
Java Developer Java Developer Roles &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
As a part of an agile team environment, you are expected to independently work on the end-to-end project delivery which includes – Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based applications. Participate in the full software development lifecycle – including requirements gathering, system design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following industry best practices. Optimize application performance and ensure high availability and scalability. Work closely with frontend, Dev Ops, and QA teams to ensure smooth integration and timely delivery. Conduct thorough code reviews and provide technical guidance to junior team members. Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues in a timely manner. Maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team. Job Requirements/

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MCA or a related field. Strong expertise in Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and RESTful APIs. Solid understanding of Microservices Architecture. Hands-on experience with My SQL and at least one No SQL database (e.g., Mongo DB) is mandatory. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and build tools like Maven or Gradle. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is a plus. Earlier experience of direct client interaction is a HUGE plus. Basic understanding of Docker and Kubernetes preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proactive. title: Python Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Python Technical Lead Python Technical Lead requirements to design, develop, and implement highly efficient, highly scalable system solutions and is responsible for delivering high-quality projects to Tudip clients. Individuals in this role should have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy hands-on programming work and good team leading experience. requirements to design, develop, and implement highly efficient, highly scalable system solutions and is responsible for delivering high-quality projects to Tudip clients. Individuals in this role should have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy hands-on programming work and good team leading experience. Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at joinus@tudip.com OR create an account at our Recruitment Portal to get started. Roles & Responsibilities Take ownership of the entire project from requirement to final delivery stage. Responsible for providing expertise in software development life cycle, from concept, architecture, design, implementation, & testing. Leading & mentoring a small-sized team on a project. Responsible for understanding requirements & writing technical architecture documents from customers. Strong focus on quality by enforcing the code reviews & development best practices/processes. Responsible for planning the end-to-end technical scope of the project & customer engagement areas including planning sprint & deliveries. Lead all client calls and email communication. Estimates efforts, identify risks & provide technical support whenever needed. Manage a small team of engineers. Demonstrates ability to multitask & re-prioritize responsibilities based on dynamic requirements. Job Requirements/Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software architecture, system design & development. Extensive development experience in advanced Python programming language & microservices. Passionate about learning new technology, domain and frameworks. Preferred good experience in Java Script technologies. le.g.react/angular/vue/knockout/node/ember/ backbone/express). Strong fundamentals in Object-Oriented Design and Data Structures. Experience in working with customers directly which includes initial requirement gathering, day-to-day technical discussions, technical demos, and project delivery. Experience in developing RESTful Web services using any framework. Experience with working on Agile Software development methodology. Experience with Linux programming, or expertise in the areas of Big Data and/or Data Analytics is a plus. Prior experience in leading/mentoring a team is preferred. Should possess excellent oral, written, problem -solving and analytical skills. Experience managing multiple projects at a time.

title: Project Manager (Technical)
jobDescription:
Project Manager (Technical) Project Manager (Technical) Roles & Responsibilities Lead end-to-end project lifecycle for software development initiatives. Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in alignment with business objectives. Create and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets. Manage project risks, issues, and dependencies effectively. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, QA, business analysts, and stakeholders. Ensure adherence to Agile/Scrum best practices and methodologies. Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews. jobDescription:
Node JS Technical Lead Node JS Technical Lead Responsibilities Developing and maintaining all server-side network components. title: IT Recruiter
jobDescription:
IT Recruiter IT Recruiter Roles & Responsibilities As a part of an agile team environment, you are expected to independently work on end-to-end targets which includes – Write and post technical job descriptions. Parse specialized skills and qualifications to screen IT resumes. Perform pre-screening calls to analyze applicants’ abilities. Interview candidates combining various methods (e.g. structured interviews, technical assessments and behavioral questions).
